description: planCollectionSync with now 2026-11-19T12:00:00.000Z and 90 days (cut-off 2026-08-21T12:00:00.000Z). Order of the steps: other space, other collection, bad now; the stale device rule; the merge; pruning. No remote file: always written. Equal: nothing to do. Remote newer, local newer, one side only, a tombstone wins. Other space and other collection. Pruning in a cycle sets prunedBefore and writes; the remote's prunedBefore is kept when nothing is pruned now, and the later of the two is written. The stale device rule (the device last synced before the remote's prunedBefore): an old local record the remote lacks entirely expires; one edited after syncedAt survives; one the remote has (as record or tombstone) merges normally; a first sync, an unreadable syncedAt and a syncedAt not earlier than prunedBefore expire nothing. Rejected entries. Bad now. A bad horizon prunes nothing. syncedAt is the now as given. localChanged is not set by syncedAt alone.
